description.fun: Guzzlord has a bottomless appetite: it eats nonstop whenever it's awake, swallowing rocks, buildings, rivers and even mountains with its two huge tongues. Yet no droppings have ever been found, which suggests it turns everything it eats into energy. It may be inspired by a black hole, and its black-and-yellow colours come from earthmoving machinery.
description.guide: Guzzlord is a Dark- and Dragon-type Ultra Beast, codenamed UB-05 Glutton, defined by its limitless appetite. It devours anything in its path, living or not. It was designed by James Turner, and it lives in the Ultra Ruin, an alternate version of Alola.
description.tagline: A bottomless dragon that eats mountains and leaves nothing behind
